Held at WATCH rather than ACTIVE because the payoff is a genuine PFS coin flip no research resolves, evERA's positive read was a giredestrant-plus-everolimus COMBINATION (weak read-through to palazestrant monotherapy vs SoC) while persevERA's 1L failure is a real class negative, and ~5 months of dead carry to Q1-2027 with a likely dilutive pre-launch financing sits between entry and resolution. catalyst: Two company-guided Q4-2026 events land in the same quarter: ARCHER II Phase 3 Month-15 topline for vonaprument in geographic atrophy, and the tanruprubart FDA BLA submission for Guillain-Barre syndrome off a statistically significant Phase 3 (FORWARD), with the EMA MAA on the same dossier already under review since 2026-01-08.
dated_milestone: ARCHER II Month-15 topline — Q4 2026 (reaffirmed in the 2026-08-12 release); tanruprubart FDA BLA submission — Q4 2026; EMA MAA filed 2026-01-08 and under review, CHMP opinion expected 2027. Next hard date: Q4-2026 (both).
instrument: Common equity; Jan/Feb-2027 calls are the structurally cleaner expression — they span both Q4 prints and cap the ~50% downside on an ARCHER II miss, which matters more than usual because the ATM keeps issuing into the event.
bloom_gates: G2 (concrete dated commitment: BLA submission guided for Q4-2026 with FORWARD data; ARCHER II topline Q4-2026, both restated 2026-08-12) and G3 (specific unpriced figure: $623M enterprise value against Goldman's ~$850M peak-sales estimate for tanruprubart alone, leaving the entire GA program at roughly zero). G1 partial only — the named counterparties are regulators (FDA, EMA), not a commercial partner; the EMA having already accepted the same dossier is real third-party validation of the filing package, not of approval.
edge: H. Residual capture is the reason: run-up from the pre-catalyst base is NEGATIVE. Both Q4 events became publicly knowable in early January 2026 (the "multiple registrational milestones in 2026" guidance plus the 2026-01-08 MAA filing); ANNX was $5.22 on 2026-01-05 and is $4.87 today, i.e. −6.7%. It is also −13% from the $5.60 close on the 2026-08-06 positive FORWARD data print and −9.6% below its $5.39 200-day average. Nothing has been harvested — the stock has de-rated INTO the catalyst window, the opposite of the VISN/SLS pattern. Remaining to the re-derived $8.75 fair value is +79.7%; to the $14.00 advocacy case, +187%. The offsetting drag, and the reason this is not scored higher: shares went 149M → 162M → 175M in six months (+17.4%) on continuous ATM issuance against ~$50M/quarter burn and $209M of cash — the "unmoved" price is partly the company selling into its own good news, and that dilution compounds until the events resolve.
analysis: Both flagged events verify as real, hard, dated and fully forward, and the residual-capture test — which kills most names in this lane — passes cleanly here: the catalysts have been publicly knowable since January yet the stock is 6.7% BELOW its pre-catalyst base and 13% below its post-FORWARD-data print, so essentially none of the upside has been harvested. The capital structure carries no preferred and $175M of net cash, so the equity waterfall fully supports the upside and no analyst target was inherited; re-derived from the ground up, tanruprubart alone justifies roughly the current $623M EV, which means ARCHER II is being carried at zero. The two real haircuts are that ARCHER II's primary endpoint prospectively tests a post-hoc visual-acuity finding from a Phase 2 that MISSED its own lesion-growth primary — a genuine coin flip that the Month-24 dual-primary addition tacitly concedes, even though the market shrugged it off (5.34 to 5.26 on 2026-08-12) — and that relentless ATM issuance (+17.4% shares in six months against ~$50M quarterly burn) is eroding the per-share claim while the clock runs. Idiosyncratic, not a macro bet; ACTIVE at 7 on unharvested capture and a clean waterfall, capped below 8 by endpoint risk and ongoing dilution.
primary_source: Annexon press release 2026-08-12 ("Annexon Expands Vonaprument Phase 3 Program in Geographic Atrophy with Addition of Month 24 Dual Primary Endpoint" — Month-15 primary retained, topline Q4-2026); Annexon press release 2026-08-06 (FORWARD GBS cohort, rapid positive responses, supports Q4-2026 FDA BLA); Annexon press release 2026-01-08 (EMA MAA submission for tanruprubart); Annexon Q2-2026 10-Q filed 2026-08-12 (cash $209.2M, zero preferred, 175M shares); FMP quote 2026-09-06 ($4.87, $798M cap, 52wk 2.10–7.18) and EOD price history (2026-01-05 $5.22; 2026-08-06 $5.60; 2026-08-12 $5.33).
kill_fact: FORWARD is NOT the statistically significant Phase 3 - it is an open-label US/EU generalizability bridge, and that bridge is the reason the BLA slipped a full year. The stat-sig pivotal was the 2024 Bangladesh/Philippines Phase 3 (ANX005 30mg/kg, 2.4x GBS-DS improvement at Wk8, p=0.0058; the 75mg/kg arm MISSED). Annexon guided a BLA off that data for 2025; FDA instead required a "generalizability package," pushing submission to Q4-2026 with FORWARD (early data = first 10 patients, open-label) as the supporting set. So the BLA is not a mechanical filing off a clean pivotal - it rests on an FDA-negotiated bridge from a non-Western population that has already caused one 12-month slip, and the same agency posture can slip it again past Q4. Second correction: net cash is ~$159M, not $175M - $209.2M cash/ST investments at 6/30/26 LESS $50M already DRAWN on the $200M Oxford facility; that is senior secured debt sitting ahead of the common, so "no preferred, clean waterfall" is right in kind but overstated ~10% and omits the drawn tranche. Against ~$55M/qtr net loss ($55.3M Q2, $0.28/sh) the cash column is ~3 quarters, which is precisely why the ATM keeps running into the print. What SURVIVES intact: both events are real, company-guided, dated and fully forward (Month-15 ARCHER II primary "on track for Q4 2026," Month-24 dual primary ADDED while retaining Month-15, completion Q3-2027; BLA "expected in Q4 2026"; EU MAA submitted 2026-01-08 and confirmed still under review at the 8/12 Q2 release). The already-harvested test passes decisively and has strengthened since the line was written: ANNX trades $4.87, BELOW both the 50d ($5.38) and 200d ($5.39) averages, 32% under the $7.18 52wk high, and down another 7.4% from the $5.26 8/12 print the line cited - the catalysts have been public since January and the tape has faded them, not paid them. EV recomputes to ~$639M (163.8M shares x $4.87 = $798M cap, less $209M cash, plus $50M debt), close enough to the line's $623M that the "ARCHER II carried at zero" framing holds. Net: thesis stands, two load-bearing facts wrong, and the BLA's regulatory certainty is materially lower than "off a statistically significant Phase 3" implies - trim 7 to 6.

analysis: This is a real, dated, forward, non-macro hard catalyst with a clean equity waterfall: a signed cash SPA with a named counterparty, shareholder approval already banked on 2026-03-27, zero preferred ahead of the common, and roughly US$997M of contracted cash against a US$367-489M equity - and critically, none of it is harvested, since the stock sits 29% BELOW its pre-announcement 2026-02-04 base of US$3.20. Verification gaps I could not close inside the lookup budget: whether the US$280M upstream actually completed by its 2026-08-31 deadline, the SPA long-stop date, and the exact ADS-to-ordinary ratio; all three are worth one confirming lookup before sizing, and a missed Aug-31 upstream would be a material negative datapoint. Score 7 rather than higher because the payoff depends on a regulator with no clock and on a non-contractual distribution promise; score not lower because the residual capture is 100% intact and the waterfall re-derivation supports the flagged upside.

kill_fact: NUMERATOR INFLATED, but the catalyst survives. Verified vs primary: SPA signed 2026-02-05 (not 02-04) with Two Hearts Investments Ltd (wholly-owned Meituan sub) for 100% of Dingdong Fresh Holding; US$717M cash, 90% at closing + 10% held back until PRC taxes settle; still UNFIRED as of the 2026-08-20 Q2 6-K, pending SAMR anti-monopoly clearance. CORRECTION 1 (waterfall): the "~US$997M total" double-counts. The US$280M is Dingdong's OWN pre-closing subsidiary cash upstream, not buyer consideration, and the US$717M is expressly "subject to adjustments based on certain net cash, net working capital and other financial line items." Q2 (6/30/26) shows only US$209.5M cash + US$57.7M ST investments = ~US$267M against US$979.2M total liabilities, and the company took a US$157M short-term loan pending end-August WMP maturity — a liquidity strain, not a US$1B war chest. CORRECTION 2 (in the line's favor): capital return is stronger than "a stated board intention" — the 2026-03-27 meeting (an AGM, not an EGM) passed a resolution authorizing the board to use AT LEAST 90% of cash proceeds for buybacks/dividends. CORRECTION 3 (market cap): ~US$367M is the correct figure (324,989,883 basic ordinary shares at 2 ord/ADS x $2.26); the US$489M print is a wrong share basis. CONFIRMED 4 (the load-bearing one): ZERO harvest. $2.26 today vs ~$3.20 pre-announcement = -29%; the tape SANK on the deal (Yicai) and sits nearer the 52wk low ($1.65) than the high ($3.41). OPEN RISK the line flagged and I could not close: the US$280M upstream had a hard 2026-08-31 deadline (confirmed real, in the Q2 6-K — "entitled to receive up to USD 280 million in cash by August 31, 2026"); that date passed six days ago with no confirming disclosure found. Verify before sizing; a missed upstream is a material negative. Score cut 7 -> 6: the event is real, dated, forward and genuinely uncaptured with no preferred ahead of the common, but the payoff needs (a) a regulator with no clock on a horizontal grocery combination, (b) a PRC tax number nobody has published, and (c) a shareholder-authorized-but-board-discretionary distribution out of a Cayman shell.

Nearly 60% of the move has already been harvested since the 2026-02-25 enrollment-complete PR hard-dated the readout, the stock sits 12% off its 52wk high and 26% above its 200d average, and the only remaining upside is the +52% walk to a sell-side target that is itself already success-weighted — buying that is closer to buying the receipt than the gain. (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: NEGATIVE ~-36%; the review became publicly knowable 2025-09-29/30 with the stock ~$4.6, it is $2.93 today (52w high $4.56, low $1.82). The offset that caps this at M: the stock has not failed to re-rate because the market is asleep, it has actively DE-rated on fundamentals (Q3 FY26 $362.8m Consumer Beauty impairment — management marking down the very asset it is shopping; Gucci license exit shrinking the fragrance stub that is supposed to re-rate; repeated guidance cuts). Unpriced here is a symptom, not only an opportunity.
analysis: The triage's central claim is factually wrong: this is NOT early-arc. The review was announced 2025-09-30, so the setup is eleven months old with a self-imposed deadline ~3.5 months out, and after eleven months no counterparty has been named — G1 fails outright. What survives is unusual and worth something: residual capture is ~100% intact (run-up -36% from the pre-catalyst base, +55% remaining to a re-derived $4.55), which is genuinely rare and is the whole reason this clears NONE. But the numerator does not hold up the way the flag implies. Re-deriving from the 2026-06-30 balance sheet, the waterfall is clean (no preferred ahead of the common — the FIP failure mode is absent), yet selling ~$1.6bn of declining mass-color revenue at 6-8x, against a stock already at ~6.75x EV/EBITDA, is roughly value-NEUTRAL to equity; only ~0.7 turns of deleveraging comes out of it. The upside is therefore a multiple re-rate of the fragrance stub, not a contractual cash figure — precisely the derived numerator the provenance rule exists to discount. Compounding it, management impaired Consumer Beauty by $362.8m in Q3 FY26, i.e. it is marking down the asset while shopping it, and the guided event is a commitment to DECIDE, not to transact — a spin outcome delivers no cash and pushes leverage to ~4.2x. Scored 5/WATCH rather than the flagged 7: real, dated, forward and genuinely unharvested, but the gearing points both ways and I want a named counterparty or an announced price before this earns capital.

edge: M — run-up from the pre-catalyst base is small: DEC was ~$15.03 five sessions before the print (5D +2.66%) and trades $15.43 now, so roughly +2-3% of the event is harvested; the +14.4% 1M move is mostly pre-announcement gas/oil strip strength, not the deal. So the event is genuinely unharvested — the market simply declined to pay for debt-funded accretion — which is the source of the edge and also the reason to distrust it.
analysis: The event clears the reality bar cleanly — definitive agreements, named counterparties (Elliott as seller, Carlyle as ABS structurer), a $50M break fee, a disclosed $548M target EBITDA, a Q4-2026 close, and two forward execution gates (ABS placement, regulatory clearance) that have not fired; only ~2-3% has been harvested off the pre-catalyst base. What holds it at WATCH rather than ACTIVE is that DEC is the acquirer, so there is no contractual arb spread and the entire payoff is derived re-rating, which the numerator-provenance rule forces me to build from the balance sheet: the good news is there is no preferred stack (this is not FIP — the common is genuinely at the top of the residual), but the equity is a ~20% sliver of a ~$5.6B pro-forma EV, sitting behind ~$4.45B of pro-forma net debt and $1.33B of retirement obligations, so a 10% error in Birch's PDP value swings the equity ~15-16%. The two specific things that can vaporize the re-derived +26%: the undisclosed ABS coupon (a wide print turns 3.3x accretion into a wash) and the ~$300M funding gap between the $1.8B price and the $1.5B securitization, which if closed with stock at $15 is ~27% dilution on a $1.12B cap. Note also that a levered PDP roll-up's equity is substantially a geared bet on the oil and gas strip — not a pure macro bet, but not fully insulated from one either.

bloom_gates: G3 partial — the re-estimated N (300 vs 728, or futility) is a pre-specified, publicly-committed number that is a quasi-readout of effect size and is not in the price; it is a trial-design figure rather than a financial one, so G3 clears on specificity but not on financial concreteness. G2 weak — a protocol-level commitment to a DSMB review, not a counterparty commitment. G1 FAILS — no named counterparty, no partner, no deal.
edge: M/L. Residual capture is the strongest fact here and it is near-total: run-up from the pre-catalyst base is ZERO to NEGATIVE — DMAC is $6.75 vs a $10.42 52-week high (−35%), below both the 50d ($6.91) and 200d ($7.20) averages, and neither the 75% (2026-05-20) nor the 85% (2026-08-10) enrollment milestone produced a sustained bid; the Q4-26→Q1-27 slip actively de-rated it. Remaining to my provenance-checked favorable value ~+93% ($6.75 → ~$13 on a low-N ~300 recommendation implying a large effect, ~$700M cap); futility resolves to ~$1.50 (~−78%) on residual cash plus the preeclampsia/FGR programs. So ~0% harvested, ~93% remaining — but reference RR is only ~1.19x, which is why this is not ACTIVE: the capture is intact and the payoff is still barely better than even.
analysis:
The event is real, dated, forward and non-macro, and — unusually — essentially unharvested: the stock is 35% off its 52-week high and below both moving averages, so none of the interim is in the price and the Q4-26→Q1-27 slip actually de-rated it. But the payload is indirect: DiaMedica stays BLINDED ("DiaMedica will remain blinded to data and treatment effect estimates reviewed by the independent DSMB"), so what prints is a sample-size number, not efficacy — informative only by inference, and the wide 300-728 band means most outcomes land in an ambiguous middle rather than a clean re-rate. The disqualifying asymmetry is that the good branch is capital-destructive: a continue recommendation commits the company to a Phase 3 it cannot fund off $43.5M at a ~$10M/quarter burn with no partner and no disclosed completion cost, so a favorable interim buys a dilutive raise, while futility takes the equity to ~$1.50 — reference RR ~1.19x on a genuine coin flip. WATCH at 5, not ACTIVE: re-rate to ACTIVE only on (a) the 200th-patient dosing PR pinning the readout date, or (b) a financing or partnership that removes the dilution overhang ahead of the interim.</analysis>

edge: M/L. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: (a) run-up — the 3Q2026 topline guidance has been public since the Jan-2026 strategic-priorities release, so the pre-catalyst base is ~$25.0 (2026-01-08); $25.0 → $35.25 = +41% already banked into the print (+71% off the 52wk low of $20.65). (b) remaining — to consensus $46.43 = +32%; to my derived favorable-resolution $55 = +56%; to BofA's Neutral $35 = 0%. So ~55-60% of the plausible move to consensus is harvested. Against that, a CHAPTER-3 miss reprices to on-demand-only (~$16, -55%), giving RR ≈ 1.0x on my number and ~0.6x on consensus. The triage note's "asymmetry largely paid for" is directionally right but for the wrong reason: RAPIDe-3 (on-demand) is what fired and re-rated the stock; CHAPTER-3 (prophylaxis) is a separate, larger, entirely unfired binary. It earns credit for being genuinely forward — it just doesn't earn ACTIVE, because CHAPTER-1's ~84% attack-rate reduction already let the market price a high probability of success, leaving the residual thin relative to the downside tail.
analysis: This is a real, specific, dated, forward, non-macro binary: enrollment is closed, the readout is company-committed to Q3-2026 with only 24 days left in the window, and it is unfired — so it clears the reality and timing gates cleanly and does not fail on the triage note's "already fired" framing (that was RAPIDe-3, the on-demand study; CHAPTER-3 is the separate and commercially larger prophylaxis arm). Numerator provenance is clean even though the binary lane is exempt: the Q2-2026 balance sheet shows €318M cash (up from €292M after a $132M raise), runway into 2028, and no preferred stack or structural debt ahead of the ~70M common shares, so the $2.46B market cap is an honest equity claim on the franchise — none of the FIP-style waterfall leakage. What caps it is residual capture, not event quality: +41% of run-up is already in the price from the pre-guidance base against ~+32% remaining to consensus and a -55% downside to on-demand-only value, and the stock is trading at its 50d average into a print the market plainly expects to hit. Score the remaining capture, not the catalyst — WATCH at 5, and the only sane expression is defined-risk optionality rather than the equity.

edge: M. This is a clean binary on one regulator. The cash price is contractual, so the upside needs no provenance re-derivation. Undisturbed base: the $16 price was about a 50% premium to the 90-day VWAP, which puts the base near $10.67. Run-up from that base to today's $12.67 is +18.7%. Remaining to $16.00 is +26.3%. analysis: Verified: WU/IMXI $16 all-cash deal (announced 2025-08-10). NYDFS approved 2026-08-13. That same day the DFPI suspended the extension of its approval that it had granted on 2026-07-31, citing the need to re-review after six months and the deal's effect on California operations. Both companies have said they will seek reinstatement and close promptly once it comes. IMXI is at $12.67 (FMP, 2026-10-12), a 26.3% gross spread with roughly 17% downside to standalone value, so the reward-to-risk is about 1.5:1 and the market implies about 38% odds. The gaps: I found no news after mid-August on whether DFPI has reinstated, whether the Nov 10 outside date has been or will be extended, or how large the termination fee is (the PR says only that fees 'could' apply). The trigger may therefore slip past Nov 10 rather than resolve, which is why the score is 6 rather than 7.
primary_source: Western Union 8-K Ex-99.1 / BusinessWire 'Western Union and Intermex Provide Update on Pending Acquisition' (2026-08-14, describing the DFPI letter dated 2026-08-13); Crowdfund Insider (2026-08) on the NYDFS approval; Nov 10 outside date per Intermex 10-Q filed ~2026-08-10 (as press reports cite it); FMP quote IMXI $12.67 (2026-10-12)
kill_fact: Confirmed against primary sources (Business Wire/GlobeNewswire PR of 2026-08-13/14, WU 8-K exhibit): the $16.00 all-cash deal; NYDFS approval; the DFPI letter of 2026-08-13 suspending the extension it had granted on 07-31 'based on a need to further review the transaction'; and both companies saying they will close promptly once DFPI reinstates. IMXI is at $12.67 (FMP live), below its 50-day average of 12.98 and its 200-day of 14.66, against a 52-week high of 15.95. The spread widened after the suspension, so the market is pricing real break risk. Nothing has been published in about 2 months (no FMP news, PR or web hit after 08-14), so the trigger has not fired and has no date. The Nov 10 2026 outside date, its extension mechanics and the termination fee are all UNVERIFIED: I found no merger agreement termination article. The line's own claim that the timing is load-bearing therefore has no primary support. A DFPI 're-review' after 6 months, looking at California operations (Intermex's key growth market), points to conditions or remedies or a long slip rather than a quick reinstatement. The numerator is clean (cash consideration, no waterfall issue), and nothing has been harvested yet; the price sits about 26% below the deal price. The edge is legitimate, but the timing is unknowable and the fee is unconfirmed, so I cut it from 6 to 4. Corrections: the outside date and fee must be pulled from the merger agreement (8-K Ex 2.1, Aug 2025) before sizing, and the resolution may be a slip or extension rather than a binary outcome on Nov 10.

catalyst: Dominion Energy is being acquired by NextEra Energy in a signed all-stock merger at a fixed 0.8138 NEE-per-D ratio; both shareholder votes cleared 03-Sep-2026 and the remaining gates are five regulators, led by the Virginia SCC.
dated_milestone: Virginia SCC evidentiary hearings begin 17-Nov-2026; statutory 180-day final-order deadline 11-Jan-2027 (application deemed complete 15-Jul-2026). South Carolina hearing 08-Dec-2026 with order due 29-Jan-2027. Closing itself is guided to 2H-2027 (NC, SC, FERC, NRC still outstanding).
instrument: Common equity. The only clean expression is the hedged pair: long D vs short 0.8138 NEE to isolate the spread. Unhedged long D is a 0.81-delta NEE proxy with the upside capped at the exchange ratio.
bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: NextEra Energy, executed Agreement and Plan of Merger 15-May-2026) and G2 (concrete commitment: fixed 0.8138 exchange ratio, ~$66.8bn, 74.5/25.5 pro-forma split). G3 FAILS - there is no unpriced figure; the ~3% spread IS the market's fully-published estimate of the remaining gap, and every term has been in a DEFM14A since July.
edge: L. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: pre-catalyst base $61.73 (close 15-May-2026, last print before the 18-May announcement) to today $65.84 = run-up +6.66% already harvested. Remaining from $65.84 to the provenance-checked deal value $67.89 (0.8138 x NEE $83.43) = +3.11%, i.e. ~67% of the announced-value move is gone and only ~33% is left. That +3.11% is spread over a guided 2H-2027 close (~15 months) = ~2.4%/yr gross, roughly at or below cash, before NEE borrow. Break risk is asymmetric: a failed deal reverts toward the $61.73 standalone base or lower (-6.2%+), so the reference R:R is about 0.5:1. Unhedged the position is not an arb at all - it is a long-utility/NEE beta bet whose upside is contractually capped at the ratio, and NEE has fallen from a $98.75 52wk high to $83.43, which is where D's recent drawdown from $72.99 actually came from.
analysis: The event is real, contractual and genuinely forward - the 11-Jan-2027 Virginia SCC deadline and the 17-Nov-2026 hearing are hard dated gates, and neither has been resolved. But UNFIRED is not UNPRICED: two-thirds of the deal-value move was captured on the 18-May gap (+9.4% in one session, 40mm shares) and what is left is a 3.1% spread with a 15-month tail, which is the market correctly pricing a five-regulator, cross-state utility merger rather than an inefficiency. Worse, the flagged January-2027 date is not a crystallization event - a favorable SCC order removes one of five conditions (NC, SC, FERC, NRC remain) and closing is guided to 2H-2027, so even a clean win compresses only part of an already-thin spread. Numerator provenance is not the failure mode here (a fixed exchange ratio is contractual, no SoP or waterfall re-derivation needed); the failure mode is residual capture, so this caps at 4 regardless of how certain the close is. Keep it on the board only as a spread-widening watch - an adverse SCC signal in November that blows the spread to 8-10% would be the actual entry.

Real, cheap, unfired, correctly dated — but the "binary, mechanical, non-extendable" premise that justified a 6 does not survive the rule text.

analysis: This is a real, dated, forward binary with no AdCom found. The payoff looks asymmetric to the downside: a CRL hits the franchise narrative, while approval of a narrow 2L label adds little to a $14B valuation. analysis: The event is genuinely real, dated, forward and non-macro - signed definitive agreement with a named counterparty, an S-4 on file since 2026-08-28, two shareholder votes and a Q4-2026 close still ahead, and hard break fees ($174m/$101m) - so G1 and G2 pass cleanly and this is not a fired catalyst. It fails on capture, not on quality: because the consideration is 1.5401 Indivior shares rather than cash, SUPN's price is mechanically tethered to INDV, and once the $1bn special dividend (which accrues to legacy Indivior holders only, funded by a $650m Citi term loan the combined entity inherits) is stripped out of INDV's $34.94, SUPN at $43.53 is trading within roughly 3% of exchange-ratio parity in either direction - the closing event pays essentially nothing. The flagged "52-week low, classic unloved-MoE de-rate" reads as a mispricing only if you take the naive 1.5401 x $34.94 = $53.81 figure, which double-counts a dividend SUPN holders never receive; the real reason SUPN sits at its low is that it is now a synthetic long on Indivior, which has itself de-rated ~10% since the announcement. Per the residual-capture rule the score is capped: run-up is -2.5% (nothing harvested) but remaining capture is ~0%, so what is left to own is the post-merger equity and $125m of unearned synergies, not the event - keep it on WATCH and only reconsider if SUPN drifts to a genuine 8-10%+ discount to the ratio into the vote.

analysis: The dated forward catalyst is real and government-docketed — NOAA full-compliance determination, Federal Register publication 19-Aug-2026, hearing 13-Oct, comment close 19-Oct, first-ever DSHMRA commercial-recovery decision targeted before end-Q1-2027 — and it is genuinely unfired and, contrary to the triage note, largely unharvested (+10.7% off the $4.01 pre-publication base, still -61% from the 52wk high). GAP: I could not independently confirm the "end-Q1-2027" decision target — the NOAA release 403'd — so that date is carried from the triage note plus TMC's Q2 call guidance, not from a primary NOAA document.

The milestones are genuinely forward and unfired, but they are cash uses on year-level windows rather than a binary re-rate trigger, and 20 months after the January 2025 distribution suspension the recovery is already 40% harvested off the low — real, slow, and mostly priced.

edge: L. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is negative. The stock is down about 20% since the Sep 11 proposal filing, about 20% since the Sep 22 lease extension, and about 89% from its 52-week high. So the market is pricing failure, not success. Remaining capture is unquantifiable on a provenance basis. The only upside numbers are inherited sell-side figures (consensus PT $20.67, or +500%), and those are disallowed. catalyst: Structure Therapeutics has company-guided, hard-dated aleniglipron readouts landing now — topline 72-week ACCESS open-label-extension data in Q3 2026, then body-composition, type-2-diabetes/obesity and SWITCH trial data in Q4 2026 — with Phase 3 ACCOMPLISH first patients already dosed.
dated_milestone: Q3 2026 (by 2026-09-30, i.e. within ~3 weeks): topline 72-week ACCESS OLE data — "Topline 72-week aleniglipron ACCESS OLE data on track for Q3 2026" (8-K ex-99.1, 2026-08-06). Then Q4 2026: body composition + T2D/obesity + SWITCH readouts.
instrument: Common equity (ADS). Options span both windows via Q4-26/Jan-27 expiries, but IV is rich into a clustered readout sequence and the OLE alone is unlikely to be a single large gap — common is the cleaner expression.
bloom_gates: G2 (concrete dated commitment): company-reiterated, quarter-specific readout guidance for four named trials plus first patients dosed in Phase 3 ACCOMPLISH, sourced to the 2026-08-06 8-K. G3 partial: the specific unpriced figure is the EV — $3.38B mcap (71.31M sh x $47.34) less $1.3B cash = ~$2.08B EV for a Phase 3 oral GLP-1 that produced up to 16.3% weight loss in ACCESS II, with a $18.2/sh net-cash floor. G1 fails: no named counterparty, no partner, no deal.
edge: M. Residual capture is essentially fully intact — the rare case where the event is both unfired AND unharvested. (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: NEGATIVE. The Q3/Q4-26 milestone calendar has been public since the Q1 print and was reiterated 2026-08-06, yet the stock at $47.34 sits ~7% below its 50-day ($50.69), ~13% below its 200-day ($54.37) and ~50% below the $94.90 high. Nobody has run into these events. (b) Remaining from $47.34 to the re-derived favorable value of ~$74 = +56%; to the prior-high/advocacy $95 = +101%. Edge is capped at M, not H, because the dated events are supportive rather than value-defining — a 72-week OLE tolerability extension is sponsor-favorable-skewed and low-information, and the true binary (ACCOMPLISH Phase 3) is 2027-28. The gap is real; these catalysts probably do not close it alone.
analysis: The flag verifies on every mechanical test: the readouts are real, company-committed and quarter-dated in a primary filing (8-K ex-99.1, 2026-08-06), none has fired, none is a macro bet, and — unusually — the stock has de-rated ~50% from its high and sits below both moving averages going INTO the window, so there is no harvested run-up to subtract. On $1.3B cash funding operations through 2028 the implied EV is only ~$2.08B for a Phase 3 oral GLP-1 that delivered up to 16.3% weight loss, against a $18.2/share net-cash floor the market already tested at the 52-week low. What holds this to WATCH is the quality of the events rather than their reality: a 72-week open-label-extension tolerability readout and three supportive Phase 2 studies (body composition, T2D, SWITCH) are differentiation datapoints, not value-defining binaries — the actual re-rating event is ACCOMPLISH in 2027-28 — and the de-rating itself is a rational response to Lilly's orforglipron winning approval in April 2026, which is a competitive-position argument, not a mispricing one. So the setup is a cheap, cash-backed asset with dated news flow, not a catalyst that mechanically closes the gap; size it as a WATCH and let the Q3 OLE and the Q4 SWITCH/body-comp prints inform an upgrade rather than pre-empting them. Gap in verification: I did not independently confirm the ACCESS II 16.3% figure or the exact Q4 readout order from the trial protocols within the lookup budget, and no G1 counterparty exists to verify.
primary_source: Structure Therapeutics 8-K ex-99.1, Q2 2026 results, filed 2026-08-06 (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001888886/000110465926092017/tm2622407d1_ex99-1.htm): "Topline 72-week aleniglipron ACCESS OLE data on track for Q3 2026"; "Data from body composition, type 2 diabetes/obesity and SWITCH clinical trials on track for Q4 2026"; "Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments totaled $1.3 billion as of June 30, 2026"; runway "through the end of 2028". Price/shares: FMP quote 2026-09-05 close $47.34, 52w range $18.49-$94.90, and stockanalysis.com shares outstanding 71.31M (retrieved 2026-09-06).
kill_fact: TRIGGER-WATCH 2026-10-06: FIRED_GOOD - Structure reported the 72-week ACCESS OLE topline on 2026-09-08 (GlobeNewswire). Mean weight loss reached 16.2% with no plateau at the higher doses, and fewer than 5% of participants stopped the drug because of side effects, so the Q3 milestone landed on time and favorably. The Q4 2026 readouts (body composition, T2D/obesity, SWITCH) are still ahead; I did not check how the stock reacted. |

catalyst: ORIGIN 3 pivotal eGFR final efficacy analysis, pulled forward from 2027 to Q3'26 under an FDA-aligned revised plan, which would convert TRUTAKNA's proteinuria-based accelerated approval into full approval and is the only event that can establish eGFR-slope differentiation versus the five prior IgAN entrants.
dated_milestone: ORIGIN 3 eGFR topline — guided Q3 2026, reaffirmed 10-Aug-2026, therefore due on or before 30-Sep-2026 (<=23 days from 07-Sep-2026); sBLA submission Q4 2026; potential full approval 2027. No exact day has been guided.
instrument: Defined-risk long calls (Oct/Nov-2026 expiry) rather than common — the downside case is accelerated-approval withdrawal risk, not a normal drawdown
bloom_gates: G1 MET (named counterparty: FDA, explicit alignment on the revised earlier ORIGIN 3 final efficacy analysis, 02-Jun-2026). G2 MET (concrete dated commitment: eGFR results Q3'26, sBLA Q4'26, reaffirmed verbatim in the Q2 release 10-Aug-2026). G3 NOT MET — there is no stated currently-unpriced figure; the upside is a derived re-rate multiple, not a contractual or disclosed number. This is the main scoring deduction.
edge: M — RUN-UP: +5.7% from the pre-catalyst base ($33.94 close 01-Jun-2026, the session before the 02-Jun pull-forward announcement) to $35.89 today. The residual-capture test passes emphatically: the approval pop has fully round-tripped (07-Jul close $42.96 -> $35.89 = -16.5%), the stock sits below its 200dma ($39.44) and -36% from the 52w high ($56.05), and the 02-Jun pull-forward news itself was sold (-7.9% next session). This is genuinely unharvested — the rare case that survives the VISN/SLS screen. REMAINING: +53% to today's $35.89 versus a derived favorable-resolution value of ~$55. Edge is M not H because (a) G3 fails — the numerator is my own comp multiple, not a disclosed figure; (b) a confirmatory eGFR win is the base case, not a surprise (Phase 2b eGFR supported it and every prior entrant confirmed eGFR), so a plain win may re-rate far less than the full +53%; (c) the crowded-field overhang that caused the de-rate is structural and is NOT cured by this event — only a best-in-class eGFR slope cures it, and slope magnitude is unforecastable.
analysis: The triage claim verifies on every checkable point and the price claim verifies more strongly than flagged: accelerated approval landed 07-Jul-2026 on a proteinuria surrogate, and not only did the stock fail to re-rate, it has given back the entire approval move and then some, leaving the run-up from the pre-catalyst base at just +5.7% — so the forward event is close to fully unpriced rather than mostly harvested. The equity waterfall is clean (zero preferred, ~71.8M shares, $499M cash against a $75M term loan), so the FIP failure mode does not apply and the derived ~$55 favorable-resolution value is supported by the capital structure rather than inherited from a target. It caps at 6/WATCH rather than ACTIVE because G3 fails — there is no disclosed unpriced figure, the numerator is a comp multiple I built — because a confirmatory eGFR win is the base case rather than a surprise (so the realized re-rate is likely well short of +53%), and because the sixth-entrant crowding that caused the de-rate is a structural overhang this readout does not fix unless the eGFR slope is genuinely best-in-class. Two gaps to note: I did not spend a lookup independently confirming the "sixth entrant" competitor count, and the company has guided only to "Q3 2026" with no exact date — with <=23 days left in the window this resolves before the next-but-one re-debate cycle, so it is a decide-now-or-skip name, and if taken it should be defined-risk given the label-withdrawal tail on a miss.
primary_source: Vera Therapeutics PR "Announces Alignment with U.S. FDA on Earlier ORIGIN Phase 3 Analysis" (02-Jun-2026, ir.veratx.com) — eGFR analysis pulled forward from 2027 to Q3'26, sBLA Q4'26; reaffirmed in "Business Update and Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results" (10-Aug-2026, GlobeNewswire); accelerated approval PR (07-Jul-2026, GlobeNewswire) — 46% proteinuria reduction from baseline, 42% vs placebo, p<0.0001 at 36 weeks; Q2'26 balance sheet via FMP (10-Q filed 10-Aug-2026); price/chart via FMP 07-Sep-2026.
kill_fact: TRIGGER-WATCH 2026-10-06: FIRED_GOOD - Vera reported the ORIGIN 3 final efficacy analysis on 2026-09-15 (GlobeNewswire), ahead of the 09-30 deadline. It said TRUTAKNA stabilized eGFR and prevented kidney disease progression through two years, so the readout was favorable. A 2026-10-02 release says the full data will be a late-breaking plenary talk at ASN Kidney Week 2026. The sBLA (Q4'26) and full approval (2027) are follow-on milestones, not this event. |

catalyst: Evommune reports top-line Phase 2b data for oral MRGPRX2 antagonist EVO756 in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, company-guided to September 2026 on a fully-enrolled N=120 dose-ranging trial with a 12-week percent-change-in-EASI primary endpoint.
dated_milestone: EVO756 Phase 2b AD top-line — guided "September 2026" in the Q2 press release (2026-08-06), narrowed from the earlier "Q3 2026"; next date = on or before 2026-09-30, i.e. within ~3.5 weeks of today (2026-09-06). No release as of 2026-09-06 (last EVMN press release on the tape is the 2026-08-06 Q2 report).
instrument: Common equity, half seat at most, no adds into the print; defined-risk October calls are the cleaner expression if IV into the guided binary is affordable. The ~$8.25/share net cash makes the common itself semi-defined-risk (realistic max loss ~-43%).
bloom_gates: G2 + G3. G2 (concrete commitment): company-guided September 2026 top-line on a FULLY-ENROLLED N=120 Phase 2b with a pre-specified 12-week EASI primary — not an aspiration, an enrolled trial with a locked readout window (Q2 PR 2026-08-06). G3 (specific currently-unpriced figure): $445.3M market cap less $288.0M cash+investments and zero funded debt (only $8.1M of capital leases) = ~$165M enterprise value for the ENTIRE pipeline — the market prices EVO756-in-AD plus the Phase 2b migraine program at ~0.57x net cash. G1 not applicable (no counterparty).
edge: M. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: NEGATIVE — this is the anti-VISN case, 0% harvested. The AD readout has been publicly knowable since trial initiation, and over that window the stock DE-RATED: -63% from the $33.20 52wk high, -38% vs the $19.92 200-day average, -6.6% vs the $13.14 50-day, and it sits 17% above its $10.47 52wk low. Nothing is in the price; after the 29-Jun CSU all-dose miss the market arguably prices the AD program below zero option value. Remaining capture from $12.27: +96% to my $24 provenance-checked favorable-resolution value, against -43% to the ~$7 floor. Why only M and not H: the remaining capture is large precisely because the probability fell, and at a defensible 25-30% PoS the expected value ($11.25 to $12.10) sits at or just below the $12.27 spot — the option is roughly FAIRLY priced, not mispriced. The edge is the cash floor and the asymmetry of the distribution, not a demonstrable probability gap.
analysis: Every structural gate passes cleanly and the triage's two worries resolve in opposite directions. It is real, specific, company-committed and DATED (fully-enrolled N=120, September 2026), it is genuinely FORWARD and unfired as of today, it is not a macro bet, and — unlike VISN — it is essentially unharvested: the stock de-rated 63% from its high into the catalyst rather than running up, and the waterfall is clean (no preferred, no PIK, no funded debt, $8.25/share of net cash under a $12.27 price, so ~$165M EV for the whole pipeline). What kills the ACTIVE case is the mechanism read-through the triage only half-registered: EVO756 is an MRGPRX2 antagonist and CSU is the most mast-cell-proximate indication that exists for that target, so missing UAS7 at EVERY dose in June — and discontinuing CSU outright — is close to the cleanest available negative signal for the mechanism, and AD is the less proximate indication, not the more. At an honest 25-30% probability of success the expected value lands at $11.25-$12.10 against a $12.27 spot, i.e. the option is fairly priced rather than mispriced, and the compressed EV is a correct repricing rather than an overreaction. Compounding it, the readout resolves inside the next bi-weekly cycle, so a seat taken now is held across the binary with no chance to re-underwrite — which argues for defined-risk sizing if taken at all. WATCH at 5: hold it on the board through the print, and let the actual EASI data, not the cheap EV, decide whether it earns a seat.
primary_source: Evommune Q2 2026 results PR, 2026-08-06 (ir.evommune.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/126) — "expects to report top-line data in September 2026 for the fully-enrolled Phase 2b dose-ranging clinical trial (N=120) in moderate-to-severe AD"; cash $288.0M, runway through 2028. Corroborated by: EVMN Q2 10-Q filed 2026-08-14 (preferred = 0, total debt $8.1M all capital leases); CSU Phase 2b top-line PR 2026-06-29 (primary UAS7 endpoint missed at every dose, CSU development discontinued); FMP quote 2026-09-05 close $12.27, cap $445.3M, 52wk $10.47-$33.20; FMP press-release tape 2026-08-01 to 2026-09-06 shows no readout yet.
kill_fact: TRIGGER-WATCH 2026-10-06: FIRED_BAD - On 2026-09-08 (Business Wire, via the FMP press-release feed), Evommune reported that the EVO756 Phase 2b AD trial (N=121) missed both its primary endpoint (12-week EASI percent change) and its secondary endpoints at every dose. The company will not advance EVO756 in AD. Development continues only in migraine, and EVO301 is the remaining AD asset (Phase 2b planned for mid-2027). |

catalyst: FDA's Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel votes on GRAIL's Galleri multi-cancer early-detection PMA on 2026-09-23 — the first MCED test ever taken to an FDA advisory panel.
dated_milestone: 2026-09-23 panel vote (docketed in the Federal Register 2026-08-10); FDA briefing documents post ~2026-09-19, two business days ahead, and typically move the stock before the vote itself. The binding PMA approval decision is a separate, undated later event.
instrument: Defined-risk long optionality (Oct-2026 call spread) rather than outright common — GRAL gapped -50.5% in a single session on 2026-02-20 on adverse Galleri trial news, so the equity carries a fat left tail into a two-sided vote. IV into the panel will be expensive; sizing, not conviction, is the control.
bloom_gates: G1 PASS (named counterparty: FDA Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel, docketed public meeting). G2 PARTIAL (concrete, dated, formally scheduled regulatory action with a public docket — but it is a meeting, not a commitment to a value transfer, and the vote is non-binding). G3 FAIL — there is no specific currently-unpriced figure; the upside is a re-rate back toward the pre-crash band, and ~27% of it has already been taken since the panel was announced.
edge: M. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: (a) run-up = +26.7% — pre-catalyst base is the 2026-08-06 close of $63.40, the last close before GRAIL announced the panel date on 2026-08-07 (the stock then rose +9.6% on 08-07 and +15.8% across August); today $80.34. Note the triage premise is wrong: the stock ROSE, not fell ~6.5%, on the scheduling news, which removes the "not run-up" argument that supported the 6. On the wider base — the 2026-02-23 post-crash low of $43.03 — the run-up is +86.7%. (b) Remaining = +25% to +47% to a favorable-resolution value of $100-118 (the pre-PATHFINDER-2 trading band), call it ~+31% to a $105 mid. Against a ~$57 negative-vote floor that is a reference RR of ~1.06:1 — roughly half the plausible move is already harvested, and what remains is not asymmetric enough to earn ACTIVE.
analysis: The event is real, specifically dated, forward and non-macro: FDA formally docketed the 2026-09-23 Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel on Galleri's PMA (filed 2026-01-29), the first MCED test ever to reach a panel, on PATHFINDER 2 (25,490 participants) plus NHS-Galleri (>70,000). Capital structure is clean and needs no waterfall haircut — zero preferred, zero funded debt, $862M cash + short-term investments and only $91M of capital leases at 6/30/26 against a $3.45B cap — so common captures 100% of any re-rate; the constraint is the event, not the equity. What caps it: the vote is advisory and non-binding with the approval decision a separate later event, so 09-23 is only a partial resolution; it lands 17 days out, inside one bi-weekly cycle, which is late-arc for this pipeline; +26.7% has already run since the panel date became public on 08-07; and the 2026-02-20 -50.5% single-session gap is direct evidence that this name's adverse-Galleri-news tail is severe, making the reference RR barely 1:1. Gap in verification: I did not read the PMA panel briefing package (not yet published) or the PATHFINDER 2 specificity/PPV detail that drove the February crash, which is the single largest determinant of the vote.
primary_source: FDA advisory committee calendar and Federal Register notice 2026-16245, "Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel ... Notice of Meeting; Establishment of a Public Docket — GRAIL, Inc. Galleri," published 2026-08-10, for the 2026-09-23 meeting; GRAIL press release announcing the panel date 2026-08-07; FMP quote and EOD series through 2026-09-04 ($80.34, 52wk high $118.84); GRAIL 10-Q balance sheet for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-06.
kill_fact: TRIGGER-WATCH 2026-10-06: FIRED_GOOD - The FDA Molecular and Clinical Genetics panel voted on schedule on 2026-09-23 and came out in favour of Galleri: 7-2 with 1 abstention that benefits outweigh risks, unanimous on safety, and a narrower 6-4 on effectiveness (ASCO Post / Benzinga / Quartz, Sept 2026). This was an advisory vote, not an approval. The binding PMA decision is still undated, and GRAIL says to expect it "within the next few months". The close effectiveness vote is a risk for that decision. If the board treats the PMA decision as the catalyst, this name is SLIPPED to an undated date rather than resolved. |

catalyst: Arbutus commenced a $230M modified Dutch-auction issuer bid at $5.00-$5.75, cash-funded from Moderna settlement proceeds (SC TO-I filed 2026-08-24), expiring ~2026-09-29.
dated_milestone: 2026-09-29 tender expiration (SC TO-I filed 2026-08-24), clearing price + proration factor announced within days after; separately the Moderna contingent payment (up to $1.3B) is appeal-event-gated with no date.
instrument: common equity (tender into the auction near the $5.75 ceiling; any odd-lot preference is the only unprorated edge and is uninvestable at size)
bloom_gates: G1 PASS (named counterparties: the issuer itself as buyer, Moderna as settlement payer, Pfizer/BioNTech as defendants). G2 PASS (concrete commitment: $230M, cash on hand, SC TO-I on file, fixed expiry). G3 FAIL (the $5.75 ceiling is not an unpriced figure - it applies to at most 20.2% of shares and the stock already re-rated to it; the genuinely unpriced $1.3B Moderna contingent is undated and appeal-gated).
edge: L - mostly harvested. (a) Run-up: $4.77 close 2026-08-20 (last pre-announcement print) to $5.15 on 2026-09-04 = +8.0%; the announcement day itself was +9.2% on 18.1M shares vs a ~1.4M-share prior baseline, so the re-rating is done. (b) Remaining: +11.7% from $5.15 to the $5.75 ceiling headline, but $230M / $5.75 = 40.0M shares = only 20.2% of the 198.1M outstanding (SC TO-I, as of 2026-08-19), so the proration-weighted whole-position residual is approximately +2.4% before any stub decay back toward the $4.77 base - and the auction is more likely to clear well below the ceiling with the stock sitting only 3% above the $5.00 floor.
analysis: The event is real, dated, forward and non-macro - an on-file $230M cash issuer bid expiring ~Sep 29 - but it fails the residual-capture test, which is the binding constraint here. The market already paid for it: the stock gapped +9.2% on the 2026-08-21 terms announcement and sits at $5.15, and because the offer can absorb at most 20.2% of shares at the $5.75 ceiling, the honest whole-position residual is ~+2.4% rather than the headline +11.7%, with the un-tendered 80% stub exposed to a fade back toward $4.77 once the bid is withdrawn. Provenance check clears mechanically (no preferred, $15.3M total liabilities, unobstructed common waterfall) but flags the reverse problem the FIP lesson warns about in mirror image - the buyback is being run at ~4x the $1.31/sh net asset value, so it returns capital without creating any, and the genuinely unpriced leg (the up-to-$1.3B Moderna contingent and the Jul-16 Pfizer/BioNTech suits) carries no date and is years out. WATCH, capped at 4: a clean receipt to buy, not a gain.
primary_source: SEC SC TO-I, Arbutus Biopharma Corp (CIK 0001447028), filed 2026-08-24 ("up to US$230 million... funded from available cash on hand"; 198,105,743 shares outstanding as of 2026-08-19); 8-K filed 2026-07-16 (Moderna $950M settlement, ~$178M Arbutus share received 2026-07-08, up to $1.3B contingent on appeal events; three international Pfizer/BioNTech LNP patent suits; "up to ~$230M" buyback contingent on a Genevant Parent dividend); 10-Q filed 2026-08-12 (6/30/2026 balance sheet); FMP quote 2026-09-04 and EOD chart 2026-08-10..2026-09-04.
kill_fact: TRIGGER-WATCH 2026-10-06: FIRED_GOOD - Arbutus's tender expired on schedule 2026-09-29. Per its final-results release (GlobeNewswire, 2026-10-01), it bought the full $230M (46.0M shares, about 23% of the share count) at the $5.00 floor, and the oversubscribed tender was prorated at about 55.6%. That counts as accretive for holders who kept their shares, though clearing at the floor shows heavy selling demand. The separate Moderna contingent payment of up to $1.3B is still undated and waits on the appeal. |
